limits: Monero public chain data does not reveal recipient addresses, transferred amounts or public address histories. A transaction ID establishes public transaction status, not payment to a named recipient. Public tx_proof verification depends on the operator’s wallet-RPC configuration; private keys must remain local. Mining pool attribution is best-effort.
